note: Machine readable form of the replay case. Every value here is transcribed from the governing document and held to it by a test, so this file cannot drift from the prose it derives from. Intervals are NOT stored: they are computed from the dates at render time, so a displayed number can never disagree with the dates displayed beside it.

intervals.label: Preregistered lead-time metric: qualifying publication to ClinVar reflection
intervals.governing_note: Only this interval is the preregistered public-source lead-time metric. It is reported for this case only.
intervals.claim_basis: Preregistered lead-time metric, counted from the qualifying publication

intervals.label: Contextual: qualifying publication to the later evaluator date
intervals.governing_note: Contextual only, and must be labeled separately.

intervals.label: GEO accession public to ClinVar reflection
intervals.governing_note: This interval is not derived in the governing document and is not the preregistered metric. Its start date is the date the dataset accession became public; the governing document does not infer the exact row state at that date.
intervals.claim_basis: Registry chronology, GEO accession public to ClinVar-record reflection

honesty_sentences: The aggregate record becomes conflicting, not uniformly pathogenic.
It does not establish that the paper caused the later submission.

claim_gate_ruling: 2026-08-25 auditor ruling: both intervals may be shown when both are labelled. The registry-chronology interval may be headlined only while the preregistered lead-time interval is displayed beside it. Content-claim wording for the start of the registry interval is withdrawn; the sanctioned form describes the data deposit becoming public on GEO. The ruling authorises display only, and does not make the registry interval one the governing document derives.
